title: How to Fix Shopify App Conflicts (Revenue Leak Audit)
pain: One merchant lost $2,000 in 3 days because an app blocked their 'Add to Cart' button.
solution: Open your store, right-click > Inspect > Console. Look for red error messages when clicking buttons.

title: Fixing the Shopify Mobile Checkout Glitch
pain: 70% of traffic is mobile, but most stores have 'silent' layout errors that prevent payment.
solution: Run a 5-Tap test on a physical iPhone to ensure the 'Pay Now' button isn't covered by popups.
